children.name: api-test-automation
air-pollution.spec.ts
returns AQI 1–5 and non-negative pollutant concentrations
auth.spec.ts
request without appid → 401
request with an invalid key → 401 "Invalid API key"
geocoding API also rejects an invalid key
coordinates.spec.ts
valid: north pole lat=90 → 200
valid: south pole lat=-90 → 200
valid: antimeridian lon=180 → 200
valid: antimeridian lon=-180 → 200
valid: null island 0,0 → 200
invalid: lat just above 90 → 400
invalid: lat just below -90 → 400
invalid: lon just above 180 → 400
invalid: lon just below -180 → 400
invalid: non-numeric lat → 400
missing lon → 400 "Nothing to geocode"
current-weather.spec.ts
by coordinates returns a response that matches the contract
by city name returns the same city
unknown city returns 404 "city not found"
lang=de localises the weather description
mode=xml returns XML instead of JSON
response time is under 3 seconds
forecast.spec.ts
returns 40 time steps exactly 3 hours apart
cnt=1 limits the number of time steps
cnt=8 limits the number of time steps
cnt=40 limits the number of time steps
first time step is in the future (not older than 3 hours)
geocoding.spec.ts
direct: "Riga,LV" resolves to Riga, Latvia
direct: limit=1 returns at most 1 results
direct: limit=3 returns at most 3 results
direct: limit=5 returns at most 5 results
direct: unknown place returns an empty list, not an error
direct: local_names contains the Latvian name
reverse: Riga coordinates resolve to a place in Latvia
geocoding and weather agree on the location
units.spec.ts
Kelvin (standard) − 273.15 equals Celsius (metric)
Fahrenheit (imperial) equals Celsius × 9/5 + 32
wind speed: mph equals m/s × 2.23694
units do not change unitless fields (humidity, pressure, wind direction)
openapi-contract.spec.ts
is served as JSON and declares OpenAPI 3.x
declares every operation the suite relies on
Pet requires name and photoUrls; status is an enum of three values
pet-crud.spec.ts
full lifecycle: create → read → replace → patch via form → delete
a pet with only the required fields is stored
creating a pet twice with the same id overwrites it (POST is not strictly "create")
DELETE is idempotent: deleting a missing pet is not an error
unicode and special characters in the name survive a round trip
pet-search.spec.ts
findByStatus=available returns only pets with that status
findByStatus=pending returns only pets with that status
findByStatus=sold returns only pets with that status
a new pet shows up under its status and moves when the status changes
findByStatus with an unknown value → 400
findByStatus without the required parameter → 400
findByTags finds a pet by its unique tag
findByTags with a tag nobody uses → empty list, not an error
pet-validation.spec.ts
unknown id → 404
negative id → 404
non-numeric id "abc" → 400
non-numeric id "1.5" → 400
non-numeric id "null" → 400
malformed JSON → 400
id of the wrong type (string instead of integer) → 400
unsupported media type (text/plain) → 415
DELETE with a non-numeric id → 400
pet without the required `name` is rejected
status outside the enum (available | pending | sold) is rejected
POST /pet/{id} with only `status` (name is optional in the spec) updates the status
user-and-store.spec.ts
every login gets its own session id
login returns a session id, logout succeeds
GET /store/inventory returns pet counts by status
POST /store/order places an order
POST /user creates a user
cart.spec.ts
adding a sock creates one cart line
adding the same sock twice raises the quantity instead of adding a second line
two different socks make two cart lines
carts of different customers do not mix
a customer who never shopped has an empty cart, not an error
a sock is removed by its catalogue id (not by the id of the cart line)
clearing the cart removes every line
a price that differs from the catalogue price is rejected
a negative price is rejected
a sock that is not in the catalogue is rejected
catalogue.spec.ts
health endpoint reports the service and its database as OK
every sock matches the contract and has a unique id
/catalogue/size equals the number of socks in the list
size=1 limits the page
size=3 limits the page
size=5 limits the page
page 1 and page 2 do not overlap
a sock requested by id equals its entry in the list
every advertised tag filters the list to socks that carry it
every sock id is a valid UUID
an unknown sock id is answered with 404
gateway.spec.ts
serves the shop front page
the catalogue through the gateway equals the catalogue from the service
tags through the gateway equal tags from the service
registering through the gateway creates a customer and starts a session
a customer created through the gateway exists in the user service
JSON proxied from a service keeps its application/json content type
orders of a visitor without a session are answered with 401
orders.spec.ts
a customer buys one sock end to end
the new order can be found again by customer and by id
the total adds up several lines and quantities
every order gets its own shipment
an unknown order id is answered with 404
total of exactly 100.00 (95.01 + 4.99) is authorised
total of 100.01 (95.02 + 4.99) is declined with 406
a real sock that is too expensive together with shipping is declined
a declined order leaves nothing behind
an order with an empty cart is rejected
the order response does not contain the full card number or CCV
an order with a negative total is answered with a client error
payment.spec.ts
health endpoint reports the service as OK
amount 0.01 is authorised
amount 1 is authorised
amount 50 is authorised
amount 99.99 is authorised
amount 100 is authorised
amount 100.01 is declined, and a decline is not an HTTP error
amount 101 is declined, and a decline is not an HTTP error
amount 250 is declined, and a decline is not an HTTP error
amount 10000 is declined, and a decline is not an HTTP error
amount below zero is rejected with a client error
amount zero is rejected with a client error
amount of the wrong type is rejected with a client error
missing amount is rejected with a client error
malformed JSON is rejected with a client error
the error body at least has a stable shape and a readable reason
security-owasp.spec.ts
a card is readable by id alone, without ever authenticating as its owner
an address is readable by id alone, without ever authenticating as its owner
customer ids are sequential, which turns the BOLA above into a full scrape
repeated failed logins for the same account are not rate-limited or locked out
the catalogue page size has an upper bound
carts: the Spring Boot actuator is not reachable without authentication
orders: the Spring Boot actuator is not reachable without authentication
carts: /env does not disclose container and JVM internals
shipping: the Spring Boot actuator is not reachable without authentication
a customer does see their own card and address
user.spec.ts
register creates a customer who can then log in
an address is stored and listed for its customer
a card is stored and listed for its customer
a customer's addresses are not visible to another customer
the registered password is not returned by the login response
wrong password is answered with 401
unknown user is answered with 401
registering an existing username is answered with 409
a duplicate registration does not leak database internals
card listing does not return the full card number
card listing does not return the CCV
headers.spec.ts
sanity: the endpoint answers 200
Strict-Transport-Security is set with a max-age of at least 180 days
X-Content-Type-Options is "nosniff"
X-Powered-By does not reveal the framework
CORS does not reflect an arbitrary origin or combine "*" with credentials
Server header does not reveal a version
OPTIONS does not return a description of the API
an error response does not leak internals (stack trace, class names)

redact.spec.ts
appid query parameter is masked
the raw key is masked anywhere in a message
resilience.spec.ts
payment down: the order fails fast, nothing is stored, and the other services stay up
payment comes back: the same cart can be ordered without any manual repair
carts down: browsing and payment are not affected
orders-queue.spec.ts
a successful order publishes exactly one shipping task
a declined payment publishes nothing
an order placed while RabbitMQ is down is either refused or keeps its shipping task
the shipping-task queue is declared durable, so a broker restart cannot drop a pending task
